title: Fukk ak benn biddéew yi sukku
intro: Benn nit ci Al Quran dafa am gis-gis bu xóot bimu nekkee xale — di gént mbir yu asamaan yuy sukku ngir sargal ko. At yu bari dina ñu weesu ñu wor, tàqaloo, tuumal lu dul dëgg, ak tëj laata gis-gis boobu di am. Kan mooy ruuh bu dëgër bii di jaar-jaaram ci chapitre bi gëna gudd ci Al Quran?
clues: Mus naa nekk ndaw, ma am gént bu yéeme, ba sama pàppa sax daf ma wax ma nëbb ko.
Samay rak, yu fiiraange lëndëm, dañu ma teg ay pexe, sànni ma ci bënn bu xóot te lëndëm.
Ñu yóbbu ma ci réew mu sori, ñu jaay ma ci këru benn njiit bu mag, foofu lañu ma neex, ñu yokk ma ci liggéey.
Tuuma yu baaxul yi tax ñu jàpp ma te amul benn yoon, waaye ci barab bu lëndëm boobu maa ngi am mbégte ci ñaan ak sujudu ci Yàlla.
Allah daf ma barkeel ci man ma mëna tekki gént, mu dem ba yóbbu ma ci kanamu kilifag réew mi, mu yéegal ma ci rang bu kawe buñu ma wóolu.
Ginaaw ay at yu bari yu ñu tàqaaloo, ma gisaat sama njaboot gi ma bëgg, sama mébet fukk ak benn biddiiw, jant bi ak weer wi ñuy sukku ci sama kanam mujj na am.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
